name: mhsb-platform-plugins
description: Claude plugins for solo and small United States law firms on Lawmatics, Clio or MyCase, maintained by MHSB Solutions. Read-only in version 1.

plugins.name: mhsb-firm-core
plugins.description: Free core plugin for law firm staff: orientation, a pre-paste confidentiality check, plain-language explanation, follow-up drafting, meeting notes, an AI policy draft for attorney adoption, role-based training and a support request. Operates without a connector.

plugins.name: mhsb-mycase
plugins.description: MyCase vocabulary and field mapping for use over the vendor's own connector. Adds no commands. MHSB service-side controls do not apply to records retrieved through the vendor connector.
